name: Eight Heads
description: Escher woodcut of 1922. Listings describe 49 tiles in a 7×7 arrangement.

name: Fishes and Scales
description: After Escher's 1959 work. Listed with 49 tiles.

name: Puddle
description: After Escher's 1952 woodcut. Described as 55 sliding pieces plus a place holder, which is why this one is recorded as an inline blank rather than an extra space. Worth checking in hand.

name: Sky and Water
description: Part of the 1990 Escher run. Tile count not recorded in the listing.

name: E128
description: Sold as "E128", after an Escher drawing of 1967. Listed at 49 pieces, roughly 15 × 12.5 cm, produced 1990 in Germany for the Escher heirs, with the original print reproduced on the back.

name: E 28
description: Sold as "E 28", after a 1939 work. Article number 80 2971. Listed at 49 pieces.

name: Saurian
description: Article number 80 2984, listed at 49 pieces. Seen only in a listing summary — title and article number both need confirming.

name: Auf Weiß II
description: After Kandinsky's 1923 painting. Listed as a 49-tile sliding puzzle.

name: The Kiss
description: After Klimt's 1907–08 painting. Appears in a two-puzzle Kandinsky/Klimt listing; no tile count given.

name: Schwertlilien (Irises)
description: After the Saint-Rémy irises of May 1889. Reported at 49 pieces, but this one came from a search summary rather than a listing I could open — treat the details as provisional.

name: Picasso (art. 80 23185)
description: Listed only as a Picasso art puzzle, article number 80 23185, described as rare. The specific artwork is not named in the listing.

name: Magritte (title unrecorded)
description: Listed as a Magritte art sliding puzzle with 49 tiles. The artwork is not named.

name: Ziffern und Sternbilder
description: Dated 1996. Seen in a search summary only; needs a listing to confirm.

name: Otmar Alt (art. B4675)
description: Article number B4675. A contemporary German artist rather than an old master, so it may belong to a separate line.

name: Kreuzworträtsel
description: A crossword design rather than an artwork. Article number 802931. Included to show the catalog is not only the art series.

name: Apfel (Lufthansa advertising)
description: A promotional mini puzzle carrying Lufthansa advertising, described as late 1980s.
